lines.text: Strengths and Limitations of the Model
The proposed model integrates physical wear theory, probabilistic pedestrian behavior,
and environmental factors to predict staircase wear. Its key strength lies in the combi-
nation of Archard’s wear law with stochastic human dynamics, enabling a balance be-
tween theoretical rigor and practical applicability. The Monte Carlo simulation further

spans.text: enhances the model’s ability to capture uncertainties in pedestrian flow and environmen-

lines.text: enhances the model’s ability to capture uncertainties in pedestrian flow and environmen-
tal variability. Validation experiments on granite stairs demonstrated a relative error of

spans.text: only 4.89%, indicating high reliability under controlled conditions.

lines.text: only 4.89%, indicating high reliability under controlled conditions.

form material properties and idealized pedestrian behavior. In reality, material hetero-
geneity and diverse user behaviors may introduce deviations. Second, environmental
